```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = F)
options(future.globals.maxSize = 3*1024^3)   # 3 GiB cap: enough for SCTransform, but a SAFETY BRAKE
                                             # so a runaway step errors instead of exhausting RAM. Do NOT set to Inf.
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(patchwork)
library(dittoSeq)
# MAESTRO is optional (used only for cell-type annotation). Guarded so the
# pipeline runs without it.
have.maestro <- requireNamespace("MAESTRO", quietly = TRUE)
if (have.maestro) suppressMessages(library(MAESTRO))


## parameters
# Set `samplename` to one of P0WT, P0KO, P7WT, P7KO (or via env var SCRNA_SAMPLE
# for batch runs) and re-knit to regenerate each merge.lanes.<group>.rds object.
samplename <- Sys.getenv("SCRNA_SAMPLE", unset = "P0WT")
# Output root for derived files (processing/ and results/ live under it). The
# runner sets SCRNA_OUT_DIR="." so outputs land in our_analysis/. Defaults to ".".
out.dir <- Sys.getenv("SCRNA_OUT_DIR", unset = ".")
# Input root holding the raw PIPseeker sample folders. Defaults to 01_input/
# (the copy of the raw matrices that lives inside our_analysis/).
in.dir <- Sys.getenv("SCRNA_IN_DIR", unset = "01_input")
cutoff.nFeature <- 1500       # minimum genes/cell
# Max % mitochondrial reads. Generous on purpose: cardiomyocytes are genuinely
# mito-rich, so an aggressive cutoff would wrongly discard real heart cells.
# Inspect the per-lane percent.mt violins below and tune per sample if needed.
cutoff.mt <- 20
# Drop only the most extreme high-complexity barcodes (likely multiplets), as a
# per-lane percentile so it self-scales. Heart cells can be large/high-RNA, so
# keep this conservative.
upper.nFeature.pctl <- 0.995
# Portable working directory: when knitting, this chunk runs in the script's
# folder (02_qc_lane_merge/), so ".." is the our_analysis root that holds 01_input/,
# processing/ and results/. (When run via run_pipeline.R the runner sets the CWD.)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(".."))
path.lane1 <- file.path(in.dir, paste0(samplename, "_lane1/filtered_matrix/sensitivity_5/"))
path.lane6 <- file.path(in.dir, paste0(samplename, "_lane6/filtered_matrix/sensitivity_5/"))

doublet_lane1 <- read.csv(file = file.path(in.dir, paste0(samplename, "_lane1/predicted_doublets.csv")))
doublet_lane6 <- read.csv(file = file.path(in.dir, paste0(samplename, "_lane6/predicted_doublets.csv")))


RNAFilteringPlot.cust <- function(UMI_gene, UMI.cutoff = 1000, gene.number.cutoff = 500){
  RCB_blue = "grey2"
  RCB_red = "#B2182B"
  RCB_3 = "seagreen1"
  UMI_gene <- UMI_gene[,2:4]
  par(mai = c(0.85, 0.85, 0.25, 0.25))
  
  doublet.df <- UMI_gene[which(UMI_gene[,3]  == "True"), ]
  
   plot(log10(UMI_gene[which(UMI_gene[,1] < UMI.cutoff | UMI_gene[,2] < gene.number.cutoff),1]+1),UMI_gene[which(UMI_gene[,1] < UMI.cutoff | UMI_gene[,2] < gene.number.cutoff),2],
       xlim=c(2,log10(max(UMI_gene[,1])+1)+0.25), 
       ylim=c(0,max(UMI_gene[,2])+150), pch='.',
       col=RCB_red,ylab='Number of genes covered',xlab='Number of UMIs (log10)')
  points(log10(UMI_gene[which(UMI_gene[,1] >= UMI.cutoff & UMI_gene[,2] >= gene.number.cutoff),1]+1),UMI_gene[which(UMI_gene[,1] >= UMI.cutoff & UMI_gene[,2] >= gene.number.cutoff),2],
         pch='.',col=RCB_blue)
  legend("topleft",c("High-quality cells","Low-quality cells"),col=c(RCB_blue,RCB_red),pch=20, bty = "n")
  points(log10(doublet.df[,1] +1) , doublet.df[,2],  pch='.', col=RCB_3, cex=1.7)
  
  legend("topleft",c("High-quality cells","Low-quality cells","predicted doublet cells"),
         col=c(RCB_blue,RCB_red, RCB_3),pch=20, bty = "n")
  # dev.off()
}
```

## Data input

```{r}
sample_lane1.counts <- Read10X(data.dir = path.lane1) 
sample_lane6.counts <- Read10X(data.dir = path.lane6) 

seurat.sample_lane1 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = sample_lane1.counts);
seurat.sample_lane6 <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = sample_lane6.counts);

# Mitochondrial content (mouse mitochondrial genes are lower-case "mt-")
seurat.sample_lane1[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat.sample_lane1, pattern = "^mt-")
seurat.sample_lane6[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat.sample_lane6, pattern = "^mt-")

seurat.sample_lane1$doublet <- doublet_lane1$predicted_doublets
seurat.sample_lane6$doublet <- doublet_lane6$predicted_doublets
seurat.sample_lane1$doublet_score <- doublet_lane1$doublet_scores
seurat.sample_lane6$doublet_score <- doublet_lane6$doublet_scores

# Robust logical doublet flag used for filtering (handles "True"/"False" strings
# or TRUE/FALSE logicals coming out of read.csv).
seurat.sample_lane1$is_doublet <- as.logical(as.character(doublet_lane1$predicted_doublets))
seurat.sample_lane6$is_doublet <- as.logical(as.character(doublet_lane6$predicted_doublets))

# Track lane of origin so downstream pseudobulk DE can aggregate per replicate.
# (Confirm whether a lane corresponds to a distinct animal before treating these
# as biological replicates.)
seurat.sample_lane1$lane <- "lane1"
seurat.sample_lane6$lane <- "lane6"


print(paste0("There are ", ncol(sample_lane1.counts), " barcodes in sample ", samplename, "_lane 1"))
print(paste0("There are ", ncol(sample_lane6.counts), " barcodes in sample ", samplename, "_lane 6"))
seurat.sample_lane1
seurat.sample_lane6
rm(sample_lane1.counts, sample_lane6.counts)
```

## QC

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
# RNAFilteringPlot(filepath = "~/Downloads/Projects/03737486_count_gene_stat.txt", 
#                  MI.cutoff = 1000, gene.number.cutoff = 500, name="test")

count_gene_stat.l1 <- seurat.sample_lane1@meta.data[,2:4] %>% rownames_to_column();
count_gene_stat.l6 <- seurat.sample_lane6@meta.data[,2:4] %>% rownames_to_column();

RNAFilteringPlot.cust(UMI_gene = count_gene_stat.l1, UMI.cutoff = 1500)
RNAFilteringPlot.cust(UMI_gene = count_gene_stat.l6, UMI.cutoff = 1500)

FeatureScatter(seurat.sample_lane1, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA")
FeatureScatter(seurat.sample_lane6, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA")


```



```{r filter}
# Per-lane upper bound on gene count (extreme high-complexity barcodes ~ multiplets)
max.nFeature.l1 <- quantile(seurat.sample_lane1$nFeature_RNA, upper.nFeature.pctl)
max.nFeature.l6 <- quantile(seurat.sample_lane6$nFeature_RNA, upper.nFeature.pctl)

# Filter: min genes, max genes, mito %, and REMOVE predicted doublets.
# (The original code attached the doublet flag but never used it to filter.)
sample_lane1.filter <- subset(seurat.sample_lane1,
  subset = nFeature_RNA >= cutoff.nFeature & nFeature_RNA <= max.nFeature.l1 &
           percent.mt <= cutoff.mt & is_doublet == FALSE)
sample_lane6.filter <- subset(seurat.sample_lane6,
  subset = nFeature_RNA >= cutoff.nFeature & nFeature_RNA <= max.nFeature.l6 &
           percent.mt <= cutoff.mt & is_doublet == FALSE)

cat(sprintf("lane1: kept %d of %d cells (removed %d doublets)\n",
            ncol(sample_lane1.filter), ncol(seurat.sample_lane1), sum(seurat.sample_lane1$is_doublet, na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("lane6: kept %d of %d cells (removed %d doublets)\n",
            ncol(sample_lane6.filter), ncol(seurat.sample_lane6), sum(seurat.sample_lane6$is_doublet, na.rm = TRUE)))

sample_lane1.filter
sample_lane6.filter

VlnPlot(seurat.sample_lane1, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)
VlnPlot(sample_lane1.filter, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)


VlnPlot(seurat.sample_lane6, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)
VlnPlot(sample_lane6.filter, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)

```



## merge two lanes

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
rm(seurat.sample_lane1, seurat.sample_lane6)
merge.sample <- merge(x = sample_lane1.filter, y = sample_lane6.filter,
                      project= paste0("Han", samplename), merge.data = F)
# Seurat v5 keeps the two lanes as separate count layers after merge(); join them
# back into one layer so SCTransform/markers behave as in v4. (No-op on v4.)
if (utils::packageVersion("SeuratObject") >= "5.0.0") merge.sample <- JoinLayers(merge.sample)
saveRDS(merge.sample, file = file.path(out.dir, "processing", paste0("merge.lanes.", samplename, ".rds")))
VlnPlot(merge.sample, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA"), ncol = 2)
```



## Finding neighbors and clustering

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
rm(sample_lane1.filter, sample_lane6.filter)

merge.sample <- SCTransform(merge.sample, method = "glmGamPoi", return.only.var.genes = FALSE)


# resolution = 0.8
merge.sample <- RunPCA(merge.sample, verbose = F) %>% 
  FindNeighbors(dims= 1:30) %>%
  FindClusters() %>% 
  RunUMAP(reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30) 



p1 <- dittoDimPlot(merge.sample, var = "orig.ident", reduction = "umap",
             do.label=T, labels.highlight = F, size = 0.6, split.by = "orig.ident")
p2 <- dittoDimPlot(merge.sample, var = "seurat_clusters", reduction = "umap",
             do.label=T, labels.highlight = F, size = 0.6, split.by = "orig.ident")

dittoDimPlot(merge.sample, var = "doublet", reduction = "umap",
             do.label=T, labels.highlight = F, size = 0.6, split.by = "doublet")
p1
p2
ggsave(file.path(out.dir, "results/figures", paste0(samplename, "cluster.umap.png")) )



```


## DEG

Find all markers

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
merge.sample <- PrepSCTFindMarkers(merge.sample)
merge.sample <- SetIdent(merge.sample, value = "seurat_clusters")

all.markers <- FindAllMarkers(merge.sample, verbose = F)
all.markers %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    dplyr::filter(avg_log2FC > 1)

top30 <- all.markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>% top_n(n = 30, wt = avg_log2FC)
DoHeatmap(merge.sample, features = top30$gene) + NoLegend()

```

## Cell type annotation

```{r, celltype, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
if (have.maestro) {
  data(mouse.all.droplet.TabulaMuris)
  sig.mouse.heart <- mouse.all.droplet.TabulaMuris[grep("\\(Heart_and_Aorta\\)", mouse.all.droplet.TabulaMuris$cluster) ,]
  # sig.mouse.heart$cluster <- gsub("\\(Heart_and_Aorta\\)", "", sig.mouse.heart$cluster)
  anno.markers <- all.markers
  rownames(anno.markers) <- NULL
  colnames(anno.markers) <- c("p_val","avg_logFC","pct.1","pct.2","p_val_adj","cluster","gene")

  merge.sample <- RNAAnnotateCelltype(RNA= merge.sample, genes = anno.markers,
                                      signatures = sig.mouse.heart)

  print(table(merge.sample$assign.ident))
  DimPlot(merge.sample, group.by = "assign.ident", label = T)
} else {
  message("MAESTRO not installed -- skipping cell-type annotation (assign.ident).")
}
```
